verses.1: To serve the LORD, to David.
verses.2: The wicked will be punished by God, but in my eyes, there is no fear of God in their hearts.
verses.3: For his eyes were drawn to him, in order to find a way out of this situation.
verses.4: His words were full of lies and deceit, and he could no longer be trusted.
verses.5: He who is considered to be on his bed will stand on a path that is not good. It’s not right for him to do so.
verses.6: May the LORD, in heaven, be your mercy and your faithfulness, forever.
verses.7: Your righteousness is like Mount Sinai; from your laws, many people and animals will be saved. Jehovah will save them.
verses.8: How precious is your kindness, O God! And how beloved are people who are like your wings that cover them.
verses.9: May your house be filled with joy, and may your springs flow abundantly.
verses.10: For in your light, life is seen. It’s like light itself.
verses.11: May your kindness be known to me, and may your righteousness guide me.
verses.12: Do not let me be struck by the steps of pride and the hands of the wicked. Do not let me be defeated.
verses.13: There, the workers of Aon fell down and could not get up.
